# phonedriver

> phonedriver is an open-source MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents like Claude Code see and control Android and iOS phones. It shows a screen as numbered text, and every tap, type or swipe returns only the lines that changed.

phonedriver is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) CLI and MCP server. It runs on macOS, Linux and Windows and controls Android emulators and phones, the iOS Simulator and iPhones. It sends no telemetry. Numbers below come from benchmarks on an Android 17 emulator; each page links its method and raw data.

## Start here

- [Install](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/install/): one-line install and build from source
- [Claude Code setup](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/claude-code/): `claude mcp add phonedriver -- phonedriver mcp`
- [Cursor and other MCP clients](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/cursor-and-mcp-clients/): the stdio server entry

## Docs

- [How to install phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/install/): Install the phonedriver binary with one command on macOS, Linux or Windows, or build it from source, then check it with phonedriver doctor.
- [How to use phonedriver with Claude Code](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/claude-code/): Add phonedriver to Claude Code as an MCP server with one command, point it at a device and ask it to operate a phone in plain language.
- [How to use phonedriver with Cursor and other MCP clients](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/cursor-and-mcp-clients/): Add phonedriver to Cursor or any MCP client that starts a stdio server, with a JSON entry, an optional device setting and the list of tools it exposes.
- [How to control an Android emulator with phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/android-emulator/): Start an Android emulator, check phonedriver sees it, and drive it. Includes the headless flags used in the benchmarks and how to use an emulator on another machine.
- [How to control a real Android phone with phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/android-phone/): Turn on USB debugging or Wi-Fi debugging, connect an Android phone or tablet, and let an agent operate it with phonedriver. Notes on what has and has not been tested.
- [How to control the iOS Simulator with phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/ios-simulator/): Boot an iPhone Simulator on a Mac and let an agent drive it with phonedriver. Needs Xcode and XcodeGen. Covers the first-run runner build and the Simulator's tap latency.
- [How to control a real iPhone or iPad with phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/iphone/): Pair an iPhone or iPad, set up Developer Mode and a signing team, and let an agent drive it with phonedriver. Tested on an iPhone 14 Plus and an iPad Pro.
- [How to keep an AI agent from spending your money on a phone](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/approval-guard/): phonedriver stops taps on Pay, Place order and Delete account and asks you first. How the guard works, how to answer, how to switch it off for full autonomy, and what it does not catch.
- [How to run device commands with the phonedriver shell](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/shell/): Run a setting, intent or key on the device in one call with phonedriver shell, and see the exit code, the output and what changed on screen. Android, iOS Simulator and physical device rules.
- [How to troubleshoot phonedriver](https://phonedriver.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): Start with phonedriver doctor, then read the daemon log and traces. Exit codes, what each means, and the errors seen most often with another UiAutomation client, WebViews and device setup.

## Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](https://phonedriver.dev/benchmarks/): speed against adb and phone-harness with p50, p95 and confidence intervals; agent token counts; real phone jobs (pending)
- [Raw speed samples](https://phonedriver.dev/benchmarks/data/speed-samples.csv)

## Comparisons

- [phonedriver vs adb](https://phonedriver.dev/compare/adb/): phonedriver against plain adb on an Android emulator. 98x faster UI tree reads, 41x faster screenshots, 19x faster typing, and a bare tap that is only 1.1 to 1.7 times faster. What adb still does better.
- [phonedriver vs mobile-mcp](https://phonedriver.dev/compare/mobile-mcp/): Two MCP servers that let an AI agent control a phone. What each reads, installs, waits for and sends, with the speed and token figures we do and do not have for mobile-mcp.
- [phonedriver vs phone-harness](https://phonedriver.dev/compare/phone-harness/): phonedriver against phone-harness 0.3.3 on speed, tokens, how each reads and drives a phone, telemetry and license. Measured on one emulator with both tools interleaved.

## Blog

- [How phonedriver reads a phone's screen 98x faster than adb](https://phonedriver.dev/blog/how-phonedriver-reads-a-screen-98x-faster-than-adb/): The on-device agent, UiAutomation, an H.264 stream and frame-change detection behind phonedriver's 24.0 ms read of a 1,000-row list against 2,352.4 ms for adb, the fixes we measured, and how we measured them.
- ["phonedriver vs mobile-mcp vs phone-harness vs adb: benchmarked on real phone jobs"](https://phonedriver.dev/blog/phonedriver-vs-mobile-mcp-vs-phone-harness-vs-adb-real-phone-jobs/): The method and the slots for results of a benchmark that gives Claude nine jobs only a phone can do, with phonedriver, mobile-mcp, phone-harness and adb. Results are marked pending where the runs have not finished.
- [Letting Claude order dinner without letting it spend your money](https://phonedriver.dev/blog/letting-claude-order-dinner-without-letting-it-spend-your-money/): How phonedriver's approval guard stops an agent's tap on Place order or Pay and asks you first through MCP elicitation, what it covers, what it does not, and why the limits are in the design record.
- [Benchmarking AI agents on jobs only a phone can do](https://phonedriver.dev/blog/benchmarking-ai-agents-on-jobs-only-a-phone-can-do/): How to design a phone-agent benchmark that is fair to every tool. Jobs a shell cannot do, checks from device state, no model as judge, and why adb and web searches are excluded from the core set.
